metadata.title: 1978 add overview tab to UI, showing a live diagram of ContextForge
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
Add an Overview tab to the admin UI featuring an interactive architecture diagram that visualizes ContextForge's data flow from inputs (Virtual Servers) through middleware (Plugins) to outputs (MCP Servers, A2A Agents, Tools, Prompts, Resources), along with key metrics and infrastructure status.

## Changes

### Backend (`mcpgateway/admin.py`)
- New `/admin/overview/partial` endpoint that aggregates data from all services
- Queries entity counts, plugin statistics, infrastructure status (database/cache), and execution metrics

### Frontend
- **`mcpgateway/templates/admin.html`**: Added Overview tab to sidebar (first position) and panel container with HTMX loader
- **`mcpgateway/templates/overview_partial.html`**: New template with:
  - Header showing system uptime and version info
  - Metrics cards (Total Executions, Success Rate, Avg Latency, Active Entities)
  - SVG architecture diagram with animated connection lines
  - Infrastructure status section (Database and Cache) integrated into the diagram
  - Quick stats grid with clickable navigation cards
- **`mcpgateway/static/admin.js`**: Added tab handler for overview panel

## Features
- Dark mode support throughout
- Responsive design with horizontal scroll on mobile
- Animated SVG connection lines showing data flow direction
- Real-time entity counts with clickable navigation to respective tabs
- Infrastructure health indicators (Database reachable, Cache connected)

Closes #1978
